svg.aria-label: Circuit switching reserves a fixed share of every link for the whole call, so capacity sits idle when the user is silent; packet switching sends packets that share links on demand and queue at routers when the link is busy.
svg.title: Circuit switching reserves a fixed share of every link for the whole call, so capacity sits idle when the user is silent; packet switching sends packets that share links on demand and queue at routers when the link is busy.
svg.text: a fixed slice of each link is reserved
for the whole call, used or not
packets share the link on demand
but queues can grow and drop packets
